units.label: Scoring/drive
units.measurement: Qualifying offensive points per drive (offensive TDs/FGs; return TDs and safeties excluded; kneel-only drives excluded)
units.adjustment: None (no opponent, field-position or pace adjustment)
units.stabilization: None inside the live grade; blended with prior by drive games
units.prior: Regressed bundled 2025 offenseIndex (legacy team-EPA grade; construct differs from points/drive)
units.displayedRating: Same numeric field as the model value (no separate display field); one decimal on Units board/team cards, whole points in tables and matchup duels
units.modelUse: Bridge input: weight*(current - effective prior), share 0.50, shared cap +/-7.50 midpoint points before Elo translation
units.missingData: Freshness gates suppress stale live values; prior held pre-season; bridge skips null keys (weight not redistributed)

units.label: QB play
units.measurement: Five components: 30% all-play EPA/play, 30% ANY/A, 20% actual-pass success, 10% additional QB rushing value, 10% CPOE
units.adjustment: V139 leave-one-matchup-out opponent adjustment 4*(50-allowed)/50; V137 pressure-context adjustment; V148 recency +/-4 after prior blend
units.stabilization: EPA 150 plays, success 100 attempts, CPOE 60 attempts toward current league means
units.liveMap: EPA and success: 2025 full-season (17-game, n=32) continuous CDF; ANY/A: current rank; CPOE: 50+50*tanh(dev/7.5); rushing: 50+50*bonus/12 (floor 50); weighted, then 50+1.20*(x-50) clamped
units.blend: display = (k*prior + g*live)/(g+k); prior = 50 + 0.70*(source-50); then +recency (+/-4) and clamp 0..100
units.displayedRating: Same numeric field as the model value (no separate display field); one decimal on Units board/team cards, whole points in tables and matchup duels
units.modelUse: Bridge input: weight*(current - effective prior), share 0.50, shared cap +/-7.50 midpoint points before Elo translation
units.missingData: Canonical QB is NaN/unavailable when all-play input or reference is invalid; bridge skips it (weight not redistributed)

units.label: Receivers
units.adjustment: Partial QB-environment subtraction: residual = EPA - beta*(QB pass EPA - centre), ridge-fitted beta on 2025 bundled teams
units.stabilization: 80 targets toward current league residual mean, then aligned so current centre maps to the 2025 median
units.displayedRating: Same numeric field as the model value (no separate display field); one decimal on Units board/team cards, whole points in tables and matchup duels
units.modelUse: Bridge input: weight*(current - effective prior), share 0.50, shared cap +/-7.50 midpoint points before Elo translation
units.missingData: Freshness gates suppress stale live values; prior held pre-season; bridge skips null keys (weight not redistributed)

units.label: Offensive line
units.measurement: De-duplicated PBP hit-or-sack disruptions allowed per dropback (pass protection only)
units.stabilization: None; same-sized 2025 rolling windows absorb sample-size variance
units.liveMap: continuousPercentileValue (lower better) against 2025 rolling windows of the same game count (n=448 for 4 games)
units.displayedRating: Same numeric field as the model value (no separate display field); one decimal on Units board/team cards, whole points in tables and matchup duels
units.modelUse: Bridge input: weight*(current - effective prior), share 0.50, shared cap +/-7.50 midpoint points before Elo translation
units.missingData: Freshness gates suppress stale live values; prior held pre-season; bridge skips null keys (weight not redistributed)

units.label: RB
units.measurement: RB/FB room: 70% rushing EPA/carry + 30% partially QB-residualized receiving EPA/target
units.adjustment: Receiving part only: ridge-fitted partial QB-environment subtraction; no run-block adjustment
units.stabilization: 50 carries and 40 targets toward current league means, then aligned to the 2025 median
units.liveMap: continuousPercentileValue against 32 bundled 2025 room composites (LIVE_FITTED frame)
units.prior: 2025 room-composite percentile in the same LIVE_FITTED frame (MD-07 correction), regressed
units.displayedRating: Same numeric field as the model value (no separate display field); one decimal on Units board/team cards, whole points in tables and matchup duels
units.modelUse: Bridge input: weight*(current - effective prior), share 0.50, shared cap +/-7.50 midpoint points before Elo translation
units.missingData: Freshness gates suppress stale live values; prior held pre-season; bridge skips null keys (weight not redistributed)

units.label: Coverage
units.measurement: 75% sack-free pass-attempt EPA allowed + 25% CPOE allowed
units.liveMap: 0.75*inverse current rank of EPA allowed + 0.25*inverse current rank of CPOE allowed
units.displayedRating: Same numeric field as the model value (no separate display field); one decimal on Units board/team cards, whole points in tables and matchup duels
units.modelUse: Bridge input: weight*(current - effective prior), share 0.50, shared cap +/-7.50 midpoint points before Elo translation
units.missingData: Freshness gates suppress stale live values; prior held pre-season; bridge skips null keys (weight not redistributed)

units.label: Pass rush
units.measurement: Provider dependent: weekly nflverse hit+sack disruption per opponent dropback (28 teams); PFR charted pressure composite (4 teams)
units.liveMap: Weekly: current rank of disruption among all 32; PFR: continuous CDF against same-sized 2025 charted windows
units.prior: 2025 PFR composite percentile when available, else 2025 dl.pressure_rate percentile, regressed
units.displayedRating: Same numeric field as the model value (no separate display field); one decimal on Units board/team cards, whole points in tables and matchup duels
units.modelUse: Bridge input: weight*(current - effective prior), share 0.50, shared cap +/-7.50 midpoint points before Elo translation
units.missingData: Provider cascade; prior held (prior-held) if no current provider; bridge skips the key if null

units.label: Run defense
units.measurement: Opponent rushing EPA per carry allowed (includes QB runs)
units.prior: Regressed percentile of bundled 2025 dl.run_stop_rate (different construct)

units.modelUse: Bridge input: weight*(current - effective prior), share 0.50, shared cap +/-7.50 midpoint points before Elo translation
units.missingData: Freshness gates suppress stale live values; prior held pre-season; bridge skips null keys (weight not redistributed)
